source_policy: Original authored control cages, explicit construction sweeps and finite fitted-part placements. No primitive constructors.

wheel_hub.description: Shouldered turned hub with deep spoke seat and projecting axle collar.

forged_rosette.description: Four-petal forged washer and raised clinch fastener.

oil_cauldron.description: Deep hollow riveted iron cauldron with continuous inner wall, substantial bottom and rolled upper lip.

cauldron_pouring_spout.description: Flared open pouring channel with a concave floor, raised sides and a lowered flow lip fitted to the original cauldron rim.

cauldron_bracket.description: Full-thickness swept parapet bracket with curved elbow and raised mounting tongue.

cauldron_control_lever.description: Individually positioned construction stations retain the curved path, section thickness and fitted ends of this cauldron control lever.

cauldron_mount_pin.description: Individually positioned construction stations retain the curved path, section thickness and fitted ends of this cauldron mount pin.

frontier_oil_cauldron.name: Parapet tipping oil cauldron
limitations: Oil liquid and fire effects are runtime systems; no liquid surface is exported.

surface_fit.policy: Project existing washer perimeter cages onto each finished bowl, retaining raised clinch relief and UVs. No replacement primitives.
